messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Polish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Polish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Urodziłem się pod Julio, choć było późno, i żyłem w Rzymie pod dobrym Augustem w czasie fałszywych i kłamliwych bogów.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (Polish → English) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|--------------------------------------|--------| | Nacqui | “was born” (1 sg perf.) | **Urodziłem** | “I was born” | OK | | sub | preposition “under” (temporal/political) | **pod** | “under” | OK | | Iulio | proper name “Julio” | **Julio** | “Julio” | OK | | ancor | concessive adverb “though” | **choć** | “though” | OK | | che | subordinating conjunction “that” (introduces subjunctive) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (conjunction is absorbed in “choć było”) | | fosse | subjunctive “was” | **było** | “was” | OK | | tardi | adjective “late” (degree) | **późno** | “late” (adverbial) | OK | | e (1) | coordinating conjunction “and” | **i** | “and” | OK | | vissi | “lived” (1 sg perf.) | **żyłem** | “I lived” | OK | | a | preposition “at / in” | **w** | “in” | OK | | Roma | proper name “Rome” (locative) | **Rzymie** | “in Rome” | OK | | sotto | preposition “under” | **pod** | “under” | OK | | ’l | definite article “the” (masc. sing.) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (Polish has no article) | | buono | adjective “good” | **dobrym** | “good” (instrumental) | OK | | Augusto | proper name “Augustus” (instrumental) | **Augustem** | “Augustus” (inst.) | OK | | nel | contraction “in the” | **w** | “in” | OK | | tempo | noun “time” (locative) | **czasie** | “time” (loc.) | OK | | de | preposition “of” (genitive) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (genitive expressed by case) | | li | definite article “the” (masc. pl.) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | dèi | noun “gods” (genitive plural) | **bogów** | “gods” (gen.) | OK | | falsi | adjective “false” (genitive plural) | **fałszywych** | “false” (gen.) | OK | | e (2) | coordinating conjunction “and” | **i** | “and” | OK | | bugiardi | adjective “lying” (genitive plural) | **kłamliwych** | “lying” (gen.) | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention
- **UNNECESSARY**: `che`, `’l`, `de`, `li` – Polish does not use a separate conjunction “that” nor articles or the preposition “of” when the genitive case already marks possession. - **No WRONG or GRAMMAR** entries were identified; the translation respects gender, number, and case agreement (e.g., *dobrym Augustem*, *fałszywych … bogów*).
All other source tokens are correctly rendered in the Polish translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Polish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Polish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
